concerns.text: Phase 7 (T038–T042) introduces pole figure validation, dislocation density proxies, and lattice symmetry constraints that are explicitly absent from spec.md and contradict plan.md (which removed these as 'unapproved'). This violates FR-030 (Single Source of Truth) and constitutes scope creep, as the tasks demand deliverables not defined in the spec.

T011b and T012 mandate reading reduction levels from `code/config.py` and raising `ConfigurationError` if missing. However, spec.md US-1 explicitly lists these levels as `[deferred]`. This creates a logical impossibility where the implementation fails immediately because the spec has not defined the required input values, violating the requirement that tasks must not silently relax or contradict spec constraints.

T020 (Integrate `orix` symmetry handling) is marked incomplete, yet T018 (Descriptor Extraction) is marked complete. FR-002 and Constitution Principle VII require symmetry re-indexing *before* texture quantification. Completing T018 without T020 renders the descriptor calculations scientifically invalid against the spec.

T026 (Include 'Material Type' as categorical feature) is marked incomplete, yet T025 (Model Training) is marked complete. FR-008 and plan.md require 'Material Type' to be an integral part of the joint model. A model trained without this feature violates the functional requirement.

T011 (Data Acquisition) and T013 (Error Handling) are marked incomplete/failed, yet T015 (Output Parquet) and T012 (Preprocessing) are marked complete. The spec requires a valid pipeline where filtering and output depend on successful acquisition. Marking downstream tasks as complete while upstream dependencies are failed violates the logical flow required by the spec.

T031 (Unit test for sensitivity analysis) is listed as a rejected task in the notes but appears in the main list as an unaddressed item. SC-004 requires verifying R² variation ≤ 0.02; without a test artifact (T031), this success criterion cannot be verified, violating the requirement for testable acceptance criteria.
